# Merge by Distance

Combines nearby elements into compact geometry.

`lfs.merge_by_distance` · Geometry

## How to use

Selection limits which elements may merge. Points and mesh vertices are averaged; mesh faces are remapped and degenerate faces removed.\
For splats, the most opaque member of each connected cluster is kept.

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Splats, points or mesh geometry to merge. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Elements allowed to merge; values of 0.5 or more are selected. |
| Distance | `Distance` | lfs.float | 0.01 | min 0; step 0.001 | Maximum distance connecting elements in a cluster. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry after nearby elements have been merged. |
